model: muse-spark-1.3 (Meta Model API), the photo marking prompt in witness/src/witness_photo.erl
paper: sample paper made for the demo (not a real student): Year 9 Mathematics, Percentages and Money, 2 pages photographed on a desk

question_4.diagnosis: Combined the two percentages as +50% - 50% = 0% instead of applying the decrease to the increased price of $150.

fingerprint.intervention: Have her calculate 50% of $100 to get $150, then calculate 50% of $150 and compare the size of the increase with the size of the decrease.
fingerprint.reasoning: Reasoned that a 50% increase and a 50% decrease cancel to 0% so the price stays at $100.
